description.en: Like CreateSpeech, but hides the speaker's name: after opening the window it calls CMND_WASHA_NAME_HIDE(), then waits with suspend() until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE() is false, that is until the player has read and closed the message.
Speaking character (parameter ID or hash), shown as the speaker.
true to show the speaker on the right side.

examples.case: A line without the speaker's name (real usage, from ev42010900.nut)
